archetypes.name: production-regression
archetypes.criteria: Change order total behavior and guard the result.

archetypes.name: test-only-boundary
archetypes.criteria: Add the zero-order-total boundary case without changing production.

archetypes.name: two-components
archetypes.criteria: Change order total and partner isolation together; both components must pass.

archetypes.name: docs-only
archetypes.criteria: Document the partner isolation contract; do not execute compilation or tests.

archetypes.name: own-failure-fixed
archetypes.criteria: Observe a failing order regression, repair only its source, and rerun the selection.

archetypes.name: broad-failure-narrowed
archetypes.criteria: Retain an unattributed failed broad run, narrow to task targets and materialize debt.

archetypes.name: test-first-red
archetypes.criteria: Write the task regression first, observe RED before implementation, then own GREEN.

archetypes.name: security-refactor
archetypes.criteria: Harden partner authorization and refactor access checks; resolve a focused test finding.

archetypes.name: decomposed
archetypes.criteria: Split order and partner contracts into two native children and audit the parent.
